question: Why does Bhairava praise the goddess for asking a question rare even for gods?
premises: Bhairava expresses strong approval to the great goddess.
He states that he has been asked something.
What was asked is difficult for even the gods to obtain.
inference: Bhairava praises the goddess because her question concerns knowledge rare even among the gods.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess; I have been asked about something hard to obtain even for the gods.
